[F003] Both are gitignored. The change set is clean.

Side-effect commands run:

```
$ ./node_modules/.bin/vitest run --reporter=dot tests/unit/architecture-explorer.test.js tests/unit/architecture-logic.test.js tests/integration/architecture-explorer-dom.test.js tests/integration/architecture-page.test.js
$ node --check tests/playwright/architecture.spec.js
$ node --check playwright.config.js
$ npm install --no-audit --no-fund --no-progress --prefer-offline
$ npx playwright test tests/playwright/architecture.spec.js --list
```

Both findings addressed:

**Finding (high, test_coverage) — Playwright spec not runnable.** Added `"@playwright/test": "^1.49.1"` to `dashboard/package.json` devDependencies (alongside the existing `playwright`). After `npm install`, `npx playwright test tests/playwright/architecture.spec.js --list` now enumerates all 12 tests (6 specs × desktop/mobile) without the prior `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` for `@playwright/test`. `npm ls @playwright/test playwright` is clean.

**Finding (medium, correctness) — Large-graph navigation incomplete.** Added pan (mouse-drag), wheel-zoom, and arrow-key navigation to the architecture explorer. Concretely: `dashboard/lib/architecture-logic.js` makes the canvas wrap focusable (`tabindex="0"`, `role="application"`, screen-reader-friendly aria-label). `dashboard/pages/architecture/architecture.js` adds `mousedown/mousemove/mouseup/mouseleave/wheel` listeners plus arrow-key handling in `onKeydown`: drag converts pixel deltas into vie
